body.message:
Hi, unfortunately, the issue has not been resolved.

Yesterday, the technicians came, sprayed something in the apartment, and told us there was no problem. The perfume smell lasted for about an hour, but after that the same odor returned.

There is a strong sewage/drain smell coming through the AC, and it is especially noticeable under the AC vent. It is not a normal smell, and I am concerned that it may affect my health if it continues.

I am kindly asking you to send a qualified and responsible HVAC technician to inspect the apartment properly and identify the source of the problem, rather than just spraying deodorizer. Someone needs to come and experience the smell inside the apartment themselves.

I sincerely hope this issue can be resolved as soon as possible. Otherwise, I will have to take further action, as the apartment is currently not comfortable to live in.
